races.paceDynamic: Tuba and Lednikov will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set an honest gallop over this extended distance. Green Team and Arch Legend may press from prominent positions, but the majority of this field are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop. The early contest between the leaders should create sufficient pace for the closers to finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late challenges over stamina-testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Tuba and Lednikov engage in early battle and maintain solid tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to unleash finishing kicks. Late-running horses with stamina will have ideal conditions to pick off tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Affair Suits Prominence
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets easy time in front while other prominent horses track closely
scenarios.body: Moderate pace allows Green Team or Arch Legend to get competitive positions and kick clear before closers can respond. Those handy to the pace gain crucial tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapses mid-race creating stop-start tempo
scenarios.body: Messy rhythm disrupts hold-up horses' timing while those able to quicken from any position benefit. Race becomes about instant acceleration rather than sustained finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Tuba or Lednikov gets uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Lone leader maintains rhythm while field struggles to organize pursuit from distance. Front-runner exploits tactical chaos behind to score gate-to-wire.

races.paceDynamic: Beat The Odds will set the pace unopposed from the front, with only Brinton showing prominent tendencies in a field dominated by hold-up horses. This creates a sustainable gallop without early pressure, allowing the leader to dictate fractions through the middle stages. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, setting up a finish where horses need to come from behind. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses when the real running begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Odds gets soft fractions and stays galloping
scenarios.body: Beat The Odds controls from the front without pressure and has enough left to repel late challengers in a race lacking natural pace. The abundance of hold-up horses creates traffic problems for closers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Brinton tracks the leader and times his challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Brinton gets the perfect trip behind Beat The Odds and strikes at the ideal moment when the hold-up horses are still organizing. His prominent style proves ideal in a race lacking early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and one closer gets a clear run
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up horse like Wave Rock or Arlecchino's Rex finds racing room and benefits from the slow tempo. The lack of early pace allows them to use their finishing kick effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Odds stops quickly and multiple closers arrive together
scenarios.body: The front runner hits the wall simultaneously as the field closes en masse creating a blanket finish. Multiple hold-up horses benefit from the collapsing pace scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Celestra will take the field along from the front, with She Commands and Wild Violet providing prominent company through the early stages. With only one confirmed front-runner in a small field, Celestra can dictate a sustainable gallop without pressure, likely slowing the pace through the middle stages of this 1m1½f contest. The tactical setup creates a patient tempo that will build late, with the real acceleration coming in the final 2-3 furlongs as the prominent horses try to kick clear. This race shape clearly favors hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as they'll get the perfect scenario of a slow early pace followed by a strong gallop when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow with Celestra unopposed
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows closers to position perfectly and unleash devastating late runs when the pace finally quickens. Musical Accord and Hot Silk benefit most from this patient tempo that plays to their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Celestra
scenarios.trigger: If Celestra maintains her advantage as others fail to quicken decisively
scenarios.body: Her class edge (OR 81) and Oisin Murphy's tactical nous allow her to control the race from pillar to post. The recent good form (22-2) suggests she's ready to dominate this grade of opposition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If She Commands and Wild Violet press Celestra early creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo stretches the field and favors horses with natural speed who can sustain their effort. She Commands' previous course winner profile becomes crucial in a speed battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Back
scenarios.trigger: If Six Blue or another outsider finds dramatic improvement
scenarios.body: The slow pace allows a horse with hidden ability to make up significant ground late. However, Six Blue's fading pattern and the quality of opposition makes this unlikely.

races.paceDynamic: Aspire To Glory stands alone as the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure and set a sustainable gallop over this stamina-testing 1m4f trip. With 12 hold-up horses behind him, the pace will be steady early before quickening significantly in the straight as the field fans out. The lack of pace pressure creates a tactical race where positioning becomes crucial, but the long straight at Wolverhampton gives closers ample time to make their challenge. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Aspire To Glory Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Aspire To Glory gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent improvement
scenarios.body: He can control the gallop completely and prove very hard to peg back with no early pace pressure, while the field of hold-up horses will struggle to organise an effective challenge from so far back. His prominent style and course experience give him a significant tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and the hold-up horses can secure clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: The large field of closers will benefit from a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint, with the best handicapped runners able to quicken past a tiring leader. Traffic problems will still eliminate many, but the strongest finishers can prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Erupts
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home and several hold-up horses get blocked
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as only those horses finding clear passages can compete effectively, potentially allowing an outsider with luck in running to strike. Experience of the track and jockey skill become paramount in navigating the congestion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If Aspire To Glory sets a more genuine gallop than expected
scenarios.body: The race develops into a true staying test where stamina becomes the deciding factor rather than tactical positioning. This neutralises some of the front runner's advantage while still disadvantaging those needing to come from too far back.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems turning for home as 12 hold-up horses will create inevitable congestion in a race lacking early pace.
Monitor Aspire To Glory's early fractions closely as he has the race at his mercy if allowed to dictate on his own terms.
Check if any of the hold-up horses show early tactical speed to get closer to the pace than their usual style suggests.
Observe how quickly the field spreads out in the straight as this will determine which closers get clear runs.
Watch for Street Dancer and Captain Pickles as the pick of the hold-up horses if the pace becomes genuine enough to help their chances.

races.paceDynamic: Crystal Pier will lead from the gates with no serious early challenger, setting a manageable tempo in this small field. The prominent runners Squiffy and Silky Lass may track behind but neither has the early pace to pressure the leader. This creates a moderate gallop into the home straight where the hold-up horses Eastern Veil, Lady Milton, Kilkenny Warrior and Searchingtheblues will unleash their finishing kicks. The sustained pace and ample room for manoeuvre strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can produce their best work late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Pier sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The closers get perfect racing room to deliver their strongest finish, with Eastern Veil and Lady Milton timing their runs to perfection. This plays directly into the hands of horses who need a true test of stamina over the extended mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Squiffy and Silky Lass track closer than expected and kick approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners get first run on the field and maintain their advantage as the closers struggle to make up ground in time. Their tactical positioning proves decisive in a race where every length matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Pier maintains a stronger gallop than expected and sees off all challengers
scenarios.body: The front-runner's class tells as she quickens approaching the line, holding off the late surge from behind. Her ability to control the race from pillar to post proves too much for the field to overcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish from the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo means tactical speed rather than stamina decides the outcome, potentially catching some hold-up horses cold. Horses with natural acceleration rather than grinding ability benefit most.
